blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—La Salle snapped a two-game losing streak, routing University of the East, 112-87, in the UAAP Season 88 men’s basketball tournament on Sunday at Philsports Arena. The Green Archers returned to the win column with a 2-2 record and kept the Red Warriors winless after five games.
